definitions.explanation: The practice or products aimed at making skin lighter, brighter, or more even-toned. A major category in the Japanese cosmetics industry.

examples.japanese: {美白|びはく}⟦{化粧品|けしょうひん}→化粧品：05119_keshouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
{美白|びはく}⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{成分|せいぶん}→成分：04344_seibun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: It contains ingredients with skin-whitening effects.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}め→日焼け止め：05120_hiyakedome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}って→塗る：01174_nuru⟧{美白|びはく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}がけている→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧。
examples.english: In summer, I apply sunscreen and try to maintain fair skin.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{美|び}→美：28891_bi⟧ (beauty) and {白|はく} (white). Extremely common in the Japanese skincare and cosmetics industry. Products labeled {美白|びはく} include lotions, serums, and supplements that aim to brighten skin tone and reduce spots or uneven pigmentation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美白|びはく}⟦{化粧品|けしょうひん}→化粧品：05119_keshouhin⟧ (skin-brightening cosmetics)
- {美白|びはく}⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧ (skin-whitening effect)
- {美白|びはく}⟦ケア→ケア：10848_kea⟧ (skin-brightening care)
- {美白|びはく}⟦{美容液|びようえき}→美容液：16608_biyoueki⟧ (brightening serum)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{美肌|びはだ}→美肌：14204_bihada⟧: beautiful skin — broader term for skin beauty
- {色白|いろじろ}: fair-skinned — describes natural skin color
